# Ride Dispatchers

> Ride Dispatchers is a 24/7 taxi dispatch call center and BPO based in Lahore, Pakistan, serving taxi and private-hire fleets in the UK, Ireland, and North America. We run inbound booking, live dispatch, customer support, and back-office admin on the fleet's own dispatch platform — including Cabica, Autocab, iCabbi, Cordic, and TaxiCaller — so operators cut desk cost by up to 70% without changing their software stack.

Ride Dispatchers is an outsourced operations partner, not a software vendor. Fleets keep their existing dispatch platform and their own brand; our trained agents log in and work the desk as an extension of the operator's team. Coverage is 24/7/365 including nights, weekends, and bank holidays. Engagements are commonly structured as full dispatch coverage, night/weekend overflow, or seasonal peak cover.
